    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The 1% Chance of Survival",
      "goal": "Survive the initial transition by exploiting a 100% crit-rate bug on a tutorial boss.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From certain death to possessing an unintended mechanical advantage.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Protagonist dies in the real world due to a freak statistical anomaly.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist enters the first hub city with a bag full of 'impossible' tutorial loot."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Final Calculation",
          "intent": "Establish the protagonist's death and transition into the system.",
          "end_condition": "Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie dies in a hospital bed after a series of improbable medical errors.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie's consciousness is transferred to the System Void.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "St. Jude's Hospital",
              "location_end_label": "The Digital Void",
              "location_start": "LOC_HOSPITAL",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie's heart monitor emits a long, steady beep as his vision fades to black.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["heart monitor", "steady beep", "vision fading", "blackness"],
              "transition_out_text": "The darkness of the hospital room dissolves into a blinding white expanse.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["darkness", "dissolving", "white expanse"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie interacts with the System AI and discovers his 'Luck' stat is mathematically broken.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes his Agility stat is feeding into a Crit-Rate multiplier without a cap.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SYSTEM"],
              "threads": ["TH_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "The Digital Void",
              "location_end_label": "The Digital Void",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie blinks against the glare of floating blue notification windows.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["glare", "blue windows", "notifications", "blinking"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie confirms his character build and prepares to spawn into the world.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["character build", "confirming", "spawning"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie spawns at the Tutorial Gate and prepares to enter.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the tutorial zone.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "The Digital Void",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Gate",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_GATE",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The white void collapses into a massive stone archway standing in a grassy field.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["white void", "stone archway", "grassy field"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie takes a deep breath and steps through the shimmering threshold.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["deep breath", "shimmering threshold", "stepping through"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Debugging the Tutorial",
          "intent": "Explore the mechanics of the 100% crit bug.",
          "end_condition": "The tutorial boss spawns in the arena.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie fights a pack of Tutorial Slimes and confirms every hit is a critical strike.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "The 100% crit bug is verified in combat.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["TH_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Meadow",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_MEADOW",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_MEADOW",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A cluster of translucent green slimes wobbles toward Artie as he draws his rusted dagger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["green slimes", "wobbling", "rusted dagger"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie wipes slime residue from his blade and looks toward the distant boss tower.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime residue", "blade", "boss tower"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie hunts for 'Swift-Leaf' herbs to boost his Agility and further break the crit-rate.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie increases his Agility, seeing the crit-multiplier skyrocket.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Meadow",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_MEADOW",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_MEADOW",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie scours the undergrowth for the glowing blue stems of Swift-Leaf.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["undergrowth", "glowing stems", "Swift-Leaf"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie consumes the herbs and feels a surge of unnatural speed.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["consuming herbs", "surge", "speed"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie finds a clipping error in the boss tower wall, allowing him to bypass the final mobs.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie reaches the boss arena early and fully buffed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Meadow",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena Entrance",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_MEADOW",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ENTRANCE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie notices a flickering texture in the stone wall of the boss tower.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["flickering texture", "stone wall", "boss tower"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie squeezes through the gap in the world's geometry and lands in the arena.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["squeezing through", "geometry gap", "arena"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "The Tutorial Boss, a massive Iron Golem, spawns in the center of the arena.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "The boss battle begins.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The ground shakes as a pile of scrap metal assembles into a hulking golem.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["ground shakes", "scrap metal", "iron golem"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "The golem's eyes glow red as it locks onto Artie's position.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["golem's eyes", "glowing red", "locking on"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss spawns in the arena."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "One-Shot Wonder",
          "intent": "Conclude the tutorial by obliterating the boss.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie delivers a single, massive critical hit that overflows the golem's health bar.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "The tutorial boss is defeated instantly.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["TH_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie sprints forward, his movement a blur of broken physics.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sprinting", "blur", "broken physics"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "The golem explodes into a shower of loot and system errors.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["explosion", "shower of loot", "system errors"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie loots the 'Divine' tier chest meant for players who survive the boss for 10 minutes.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie gains high-tier gear and a suspicious amount of gold.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A golden chest materializes where the golem once stood, its lid already creaking open.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golden chest", "materializing", "creaking open"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stuffs the impossible loot into his basic inventory bag.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stuffing loot", "impossible loot", "inventory bag"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie walks through the exit portal, leaving the tutorial behind.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie transitions to the Hub City.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Hub City Portal",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_HUB_PORTAL",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A swirling blue portal opens at the back of the arena, humming with power.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue portal", "swirling", "humming"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Looting the Narrative",
      "goal": "Identify the 'Speed-to-Crit' conversion exploit while navigating the starter city's bureaucracy.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From lucky survivor to deliberate exploiter of system physics.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arriving at the hub with high-tier loot and suspicious stats.",
        "to_next": "The protagonist joins a low-stakes dungeon crawl to test his 'Hit & Run' theory."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Iron Gate Bureaucracy",
          "intent": "Introduce the hub city and the protagonist's initial struggle with registration.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie arrives in the Iron Gate hub city and is overwhelmed by the crowd.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie locates the Adventurer Guild.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Hub City Portal",
              "location_end_label": "Iron Gate Square",
              "location_start": "LOC_HUB_PORTAL",
              "location_end": "LOC_IRON_GATE_SQUARE",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps out of the portal and into the bustling noise of a medieval metropolis.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["portal", "bustling noise", "metropolis"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:10",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie follows the signs toward the massive stone building with the crossed-swords banner.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["following signs", "stone building", "crossed-swords"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie attempts to register but his stats cause a system error at the clerk's desk.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he needs to hide his true stats from public view.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SILAS"],
              "location_start_label": "Adventurer Guild Hall",
              "location_end_label": "Adventurer Guild Hall",
              "location_start": "LOC_GUILD_HALL",
              "location_end": "LOC_GUILD_HALL",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Silas, the guild clerk, taps a crystal ball that suddenly begins to smoke.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["guild clerk", "crystal ball", "smoking"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie quickly cancels the scan before the crystal shatters.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["canceling scan", "crystal", "shatters"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie bribes Silas with a 'Divine' tutorial item to bypass the standard stat-check.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie is registered as a Level 1 'Scout' without a full stat audit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_SILAS"],
              "location_start_label": "Adventurer Guild Hall",
              "location_end_label": "Adventurer Guild Hall",
              "location_start": "LOC_GUILD_HALL",
              "location_end": "LOC_GUILD_HALL",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie slides a glowing golden ring across the counter, catching Silas's greedy eye.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golden ring", "counter", "greedy eye"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Silas hands over a bronze adventurer's badge with a conspiratorial wink.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["bronze badge", "conspiratorial wink", "handing over"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Agility Loophole",
          "intent": "Experiment with the Speed-to-Crit conversion in a controlled environment.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie visits the local training grounds to test his movement speed vs. crit chance.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that sprinting increases his crit-rate in real-time.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["TH_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Adventurer Guild Hall",
              "location_end_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_start": "LOC_GUILD_HALL",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_GROUNDS",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The afternoon sun beats down on the dirt-packed training field as Artie begins to run laps.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["afternoon sun", "training field", "running laps"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie watches the 'Crit Chance' percentage climb with every yard he covers.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["Crit Chance", "percentage", "climbing"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie buys 'Wind-Step' boots from a back-alley merchant to boost his base speed.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie's base agility is high enough to trigger the exploit with minimal effort.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_end_label": "Back-Alley Market",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_GROUNDS",
              "location_end": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie ducks into a narrow alleyway where a hooded merchant displays a pair of winged boots.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["narrow alleyway", "hooded merchant", "winged boots"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie laces up the boots and feels his feet barely touching the cobblestones.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["lacing up", "feet", "cobblestones"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie performs a final test run, reaching a permanent 100% crit state while jogging.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "The 'Hit & Run' build is finalized.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["TH_CRIT_BUG"],
              "location_start_label": "Back-Alley Market",
              "location_end_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_start": "LOC_BACK_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_GROUNDS",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie returns to the training grounds to verify the math one last time.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["returning", "training grounds", "verify math"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_out_text": "The status window locks at 100%—the exploit is now stable.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["status window", "100%", "stable"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Dressed for Success",
          "intent": "Acquire the necessary gear to leverage the exploit in a real dungeon.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie prepares his inventory, focusing on items that increase evasion and speed.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie is fully equipped for a hitless run.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Training Grounds",
              "location_end_label": "City Gates",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_GROUNDS",
              "location_end": "LOC_CITY_GATES",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie checks his pack by the city gates, ensuring every item serves his zero-hit strategy.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["checking pack", "city gates", "zero-hit strategy"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie heads out toward the swamp where the Sunken Crypt lies.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["heading out", "swamp", "Sunken Crypt"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie arrives at the Sunken Crypt and prepares to enter.",
              "type": "transition",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the dungeon.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "City Gates",
              "location_end_label": "Sunken Crypt Entrance",
              "location_start": "LOC_CITY_GATES",
              "location_end": "LOC_CRYPT_ENTRANCE",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The damp smell of rot fills the air as Artie stands before the vine-covered stone stairs.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["damp smell", "rot", "stone stairs"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "The Glass Cannon Special",
      "goal": "Clear the Sunken Crypt dungeon using a zero-hit strategy that breaks the local leaderboard.",
      "chapter_role": "trial",
      "stakes_shift": "From an unknown player to a target of interest for the 'System Integrity' guild.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Entering the dungeon with a build that shouldn't work.",
        "to_next": "The local authorities realize the protagonist is bypassing standard combat cooldowns."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The No-Hit Run",
          "intent": "Begin the Sunken Crypt clear using the zero-hit strategy.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist reaches the mid-dungeon checkpoint without taking damage.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie clears the first floor of the crypt by kiting skeletons and never getting touched.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie maintains a 'Flawless' combat bonus.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Sunken Crypt Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Crypt First Floor",
              "location_start": "LOC_CRYPT_ENTRANCE",
              "location_end": "LOC_CRYPT_F1",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie slides across the mossy floor, dodging a skeleton's clumsy swing with inches to spare.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sliding", "mossy floor", "dodging"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_out_text": "The skeletons crumble into dust as Artie's daggers find their mark with lethal precision.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["crumbling into dust", "daggers", "lethal precision"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie navigates a room full of pressure-plate traps using his enhanced agility.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie bypasses the traps without triggering a single one.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Crypt First Floor",
              "location_end_label": "Crypt Trap Room",
              "location_start": "LOC_CRYPT_F1",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAP_ROOM",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie pauses at the threshold of a hallway where the tiles are slightly misaligned.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["pausing", "hallway", "misaligned tiles"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie leaps from tile to tile, his movements as light as a feather.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["leaping", "tile to tile", "light movements"],
              "hands_off_to": "3:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie reaches the mid-dungeon fountain and sees a notification for his hitless streak.",
